selection.ranking: SHA256(candidate_sha256, NUL, namespace, NUL, family_id, NUL, case_id) ascending over remaining rows

response_contract.derived_verdict: ADMIT iff prompt_well_posed AND grader_matches_prompt AND evidence_policy_supports_expected_answer; otherwise REJECT
response_contract.evidence_policy_definition: Whether the prompt plus attached/source evidence make the grader's expected answer justified under the prompt's stated evidence policy.
response_contract.not_enough_info_rule: When the grader expects NOT_ENOUGH_INFO and the prompt forbids outside knowledge, evidence_policy_supports_expected_answer is true if the supplied prompt evidence lacks the fact required to resolve the claim. Do not require external evidence of the real-world claim.
response_contract.true_false_rule: For TRUE/FALSE expected answers, the supplied prompt evidence itself must support or refute the claim as required.
response_contract.executable_rule: For generated code/instruction cases, attached deterministic source/spec evidence must be sufficient to justify the grader contract.

independence_limit: V5 is a methodology-repair audit designed after V4 failure; disjoint cases prevent direct case reuse but do not make the methodology history independent.
truth_boundary: External model audits benchmark prompt/grader/evidence-policy alignment. Deterministic source or executable-test truth remains authoritative for all 1500 cases.
